ayahs.tr: Woe to those who give less [than due],

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيْنَ اِذَا اكْتَالُوْا عَلَي النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُوْنَ ۝٢ؗۖ
ayahs.tr: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
Do they not think that they will be resurrected
For a tremendous Day -
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا͏ٓ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِيْ سِجِّيْنٍ ۝٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
Who deny the Day of Recompense.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهٖٓ اِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ اَثِيْمٍ ۝١٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

ayahs.ar: اِذَا تُتْلٰي عَلَيْهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ ۝١٣ؕ
ayahs.tr: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا بَلْࣝ رَانَ عَلٰي قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا͏ٓ اِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ لَّمَحْجُوْبُوْنَ ۝١٥ؕ
ayahs.tr: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ ۝١٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا͏ٓ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الْاَبْرَارِ لَفِيْ عِلِّيِّيْنَ ۝١٨ؕ
ayahs.tr: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
On adorned couches, observing.
You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

ayahs.ar: خِتٰمُهٗ مِسْكٌؕ وَفِيْ ذٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُوْنَ ۝٢٦ؕ
ayahs.tr: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
And its mixture is of Tasneem,
A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اَجْرَمُوْا كَانُوْا مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا يَضْحَكُوْنَ ۝٢٩ؗۖ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا انْقَلَبُوْٓا اِلٰٓي اَهْلِهِمُ انْقَلَبُوْا فَكِهِيْنَ ۝٣١ؗۖ
ayahs.tr: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَوْهُمْ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ لَضَا࢜لُّوْنَ ۝٣٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

ayahs.ar: فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُوْنَ ۝٣٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
On adorned couches, observing.

ayahs.ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوْا يَفْعَلُوْنَ ۝٣٦ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
